title: Real-Time Interface Generator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Builds application interfaces from user needs and adapts them to different screen sizes and devices. A proposed generator that builds application interfaces directly from stated user needs: it derives the necessary controls, layouts, and flows, then adapts them in real time to screen size, device, and accessibility requirements. When the underlying application changes, the interface regenerates rather than going stale.
capabilities: Derive controls and flows from user needs
Generate layouts for phones, tablets, desktops, and more
Adapt to accessibility requirements automatically
Regenerate interfaces when the application changes
Test generated interfaces against usability heuristics
